selection: First16 image-content SHA identities of the fresh cohort; both queries, no outcome filtering.
normal_path: Identity-order streaming for the already frozen N=32, no-rescue, quarter-cap policy. Each query performs one original prefill and at most one selected trial.
input_only_native_reference: Reuse the independently repeated full native capture for exact parity; reference access and hashes excluded from timings.
timing: All32 queries arrive together; every arm processes the same sample-identity order and returns each mask after that query finishes. Timers include preprocessing, real Qwen/SAM, CPU readouts and online systematic rounding.
batch_policy_equivalence: Because sum_i .25*eligible_i <= N/4 for N divisible by4, the shared cap is nonbinding. Identity-order prefix rounding gives exactly the frozen batch trial mask; verify every timed repeat.
memory_note: Audit retains detached per-query tensors until end of block; peak memory is for the audited path.
